Title: Information on: What did Pinochet do to his political opponents?...
Augusto Pinochet, the Chilean military dictator from 1973 to 1990, was accused of human rights violations against his political opponents during his regime. Thousands were arrested, tortured, or disappeared, and hundreds were killed. The National Commission on Truth and Reconciliation estimated that approximately 3,200 people were killed or disappeared under Pinochet's rule.
--- End Document 1 ---
